label: offline-native-basin-waterworks-prototype
authority: Offline authored actual-engine native basin study. Candidate geometry and an original native vector scene are injected in local memory. A separate guarded layout-owned native pond changes basin terrain and water through native functions. Authored colliders and player physics bodies are preserved; one new water body is added. The dry 12-case upper-route proof does not certify this wet study. No authenticated Figma capture, asset-master approval, production activation or final gameplay/release approval is claimed.
renderer: Actual built dist served read-only; prototype overlays and observer confined to local responses. Ordinary MaxLevels build and real game physics/rendering are used. PNGs have no image resizing.

basinContract.terrainBehavior: One layout-owned pond returned through an explicit guarded pondInBucket adapter; original native terrain depression, renderer and water physics consume it. Native terrain heights in the basin differ from the dry study.

stories.name: phone
stories.inputMethod: Actual Playwright keyboard controls after one initial supported dry-soil spawn. The separate native pond fixture is initialized before input; no actor placement, pose changes, clock edits, water edits or health edits occur after input starts.
stories.coverage: Mech class in this viewport crosses the real basin, jumps/swims back to the dry court, reaches the central pier and two upper galleries, returns through both ladders and plants on dry soil. Independent four-class/rate basin physics and dry upper-route reports remain separate.
